guidance: We have kind of already hit that target in the first six months of the year, with almost INR1,000 crores of disbursement during the quarter.

capex: Fees, commission, and brokerage income increased by 38% quarter -on-quarter to INR 520 crores on the back of investment banking transactions and growth in recurring AUM in the wealth management business.
We have tremendous leverage capacity because we have limits to go up to 4x debt equity in this business, and we are at 0.8.

Sir, on the wealth management side, we have been focusing on productivity.
We will have 18 months to two years of strong recruitment, and then we will focus one year, one and a half years on making it much more productive.
